policy: Append immutable native12 originals after V9. Entire official-digest ZIP is retained in 18 base64 parts; member Git IDs are computed, not separate-upload claims. Full job log and API/MCP envelopes preserve CRLF. Reuse 11 actual existing objects with fresh full GET; create 38 new blobs with base64+fullGET. For every item actual_registered_blob_sha is the common actual-ID field; one published-source reuse intentionally has no fabricated create_blob receipt. No signed download authorization included. No ref/native/dispatch/rerun/cancel/timeout mutation by this auditor.
limits: The two owned cmd lifetimes qualify only this fixed observation; arbitrary descendants, breakaway, cancellation and product isolation are not qualified.
Full restricting token, ambient reads, loader and descendant lifetime remain unqualified.
Helper INFINITE wait and Command.status were not given new deadlines.
No rustfmt gate was run by this verifier.
This receipt does not convert the original failing target or job into success.
Native12 passing test capture omitted 60 per-object new-cohort ACL/identity dumps; successful runtime guards are a source-bound inference, not invented raw output.
Complete native index and lock bytes were not archived; original recorded fingerprints remain stable.
